newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids mixed.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring wheat bids were mixed on Monday and movement was slow as farmers focused on fieldwork, several cash grain dealers said.

Spring wheat crop conditions improved in the week ended Sunday. The U.S. Agriculture Department said 52 percent of the crop was rated good to excellent, up from 50 percent last week. Merchandisers said much-needed rains fell over the weekend, improving crop prospects.
"It got rained on again twice this weekend and that helped matters," a Montana dealer said. "We had a string of hot, dry days last week that had some guys worried."

Merchandisers said farmers remained reluctant to sell new or old crop supplies as prices were well below last year's levels. Last year's winter and spring wheat crops were in short supply while this year's crop looks to be abundant.
Dealers said farmers would either store their crops or put them under nine-month Farm Service Agency loans in hopes of higher prices.
"They're going to put a good chunk of it under (government) loan," a Minnesota dealer said. "They'd be crazy not to. "
